title: ECF Domain
description: Canonical ECF Domain enumeration. One of seven axiom-derived concern dimensions (CR-ECF-003, CR-ECF-005; domain set extended by CR-ECF-006). Domain 3 renamed from 'PeopleAndOrganization' to 'AgencyAndOrganization' by CR-ECF-007 (substrate independence; ADR-ECF-002). Deprecated aliases for backward compatibility: ['PeopleAndOrganization', 'peopleAndOrganization', 'people-organization', 'People & Organization']. See CR-ECF-007 §6.2 and ADR-ECF-002 §6.3 for the migration policy.
